tools.name: list_company_interviews
tools.description: Lists the 42 companies Aethel has a page on, for their AI interview: the company, who runs its interview as Aethel's page says (an AI, a person, or recorded questions), the page's address, and the day the company's own pages were read.

tools.name: get_company_interview
tools.description: What one company's own pages say about its AI interview (length, format, retakes, recording, rules and more), topic by topic, each with the company page it rests on and the day it was read, then what those pages do not say, Aethel's page on the company and the free practice. An unknown name answers

tools.name: compare_across_companies
tools.description: One question, answered for every company whose own pages say: who runs the interview (an AI or a person), whether it is recorded, whether it can be retaken, or how long it is. Each row has the company page it rests on and the day it was read; companies whose pages do not say are listed as not known.

tools.name: about_practice
tools.description: What Aethel's free AI interview practice is (roles and levels, typed or spoken answers, an instant check that quotes the person's own words, no account, nothing saved), what the free full interview is (about 15 minutes, with an AI interviewer that says it is an AI), and the addresses.
